what_this_proves: Capability Genesis is reachable from the product and cannot register unsafe code. An interface the owner registers (or discovers from its own description) is a row that rebuilds the spoken-name catalogue at once and after a restart; a request has a route; a non-loopback host is researched only when the owner enrolled it as an authorized asset with network permission on itself; every generated adapter - rendered or model-proposed - passes a deterministic security gate before a single test runs and is refused by name when it fails; the model is asked only under the owner's flag, may replace only the adapter module, and everything it writes waits for the owner; a capability can be versioned, rolled back, deactivated, re-activated and used through the registry's own gates.

measured_first.before: GenesisInterfaceCatalogue was an in-memory list with a register() nobody called (empty in every production process; the corpus seeded it per case); requests came only from capability.request (voice) or a test; fetch_interface refused every non-loopback host; no security gate on generated code (supply-chain scan on declared dependencies only); HttpAdapterGenerator had no model seam; request() reused an existing capability and could not build a new version; no rollback/deactivate/activate/use route; the matrix said 575 (voice tool) and 578 (restricted generation) were missing - both were measurement errors (the four tools exist since M24; the generator already covers every spec-subset interface).

found_on_the_way.registry_rollback_early_return: rollback_to returned the row unchanged when the target was already the current version, so activate() after deactivate() could not restore production; the early return now applies only when the capability is already production, otherwise it re-serves the registered version (a registered_at check guards it).
found_on_the_way.route_answered_with_the_exception: the catalogue registration route first answered a shape error with str(exc); the owner-language test caught it on the first run - a fixed sentence now, the reason in the log.
found_on_the_way.matrix_pipe_again: row 574 carried '|' between route names and split for the web sync; spelled with slashes. Twice in one day: a rule for the writer.
found_on_the_way.port_precedence: the first draft of the host rule wrote `A or B and C` where `A or (C and B)` was meant; caught by reading it back before the tests ran.

red_first_proof.method: Executed mutations restored from sha256-verified copies (never git checkout); scratchpad b36_mutate.py, log b36_mutate.log.
mutations: M1 the security gate records its findings but never refuses an adapter -> 1 failure (hostile proposal registered).
M2 a model-written read adapter is registered without the owner's word -> 1 failure (verified instead of awaiting_approval).
M3 the model is asked with the owner's flag off -> 1 failure (model.asked not empty).
M4 any host on the internet may be researched -> 1 failure (validation_error expected, network attempted).
M5 a generated adapter may name a foreign host -> 1 failure (evil.example.com not a finding).
M6 disabling a catalogue entry leaves it resolvable by voice -> 1 failure (still resolved after disable).
M7 an enrolled asset with no network grant authorizes research -> 1 failure (other.example.invalid allowed).
M8 activate() after a deactivation leaves the capability unresolvable -> 1 failure (resolve None after activate).
red_first_proof.result: 8/8 red; every file restored to its sha256 before the mutation

runtime_proof.status: PROVEN_AUTOMATED with real processes: the counter box fixture is a real HTTP application on a loopback port, the adapters are executed in subprocesses by the dispatcher, the routes run through create_app with an owner session. The production round (register a real local application on the deployed Cloud Core, ask for it by voice, use it) needs the deploy and is READY_FOR_OWNER.

owner_gates.production_round: READY_FOR_OWNER: after the deploy, POST /v1/genesis/catalogue with a real interface, say its spoken name, watch the run on /selfdev.
owner_gates.model_generation: genesis_model_generation_enabled stays off until the owner turns it on (and supplies PAGENTOS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY); every model-written adapter waits for the owner regardless.
owner_gates.authorized_hosts: a non-loopback interface is researched only after the owner enrols its host as an asset with network permission on itself (POST /v1/security/assets).
